probes.name: readonly-font
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As FormatCondition,g As FormatCondition
On Error GoTo Failed
Range("A1:A3").Value=20
Range("A1:A3").Font.Bold=True
Set f=Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlGreater,10)
f.Font.Bold=False
f.StopIfTrue=False
Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Font.Bold=True
Probe=ReadDisplay()
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function ReadDisplay() As String
Dim c As Range
For Each c In Range("A1:A3")
ReadDisplay=ReadDisplay & c.Address & ":" & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold) & "," & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Italic) & "," & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Interior.Color) & "," & c.DisplayFormat.NumberFormat & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
End Function

probes.name: border-compose
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As FormatCondition,g As FormatCondition
On Error GoTo Failed
Range("A1:A3").Value=20
Range("A1:A3").Font.Bold=True
Set f=Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlGreater,10)
f.Font.Bold=False
f.StopIfTrue=False
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=255
Set g=Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=TRUE")
g.Borders(xlBottom).LineStyle=xlDash
g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=16711680
Probe=CStr(Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).LineStyle) & "|" & CStr(Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).Color)
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function ReadDisplay() As String
Dim c As Range
For Each c In Range("A1:A3")
ReadDisplay=ReadDisplay & c.Address & ":" & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold) & "," & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Italic) & "," & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Interior.Color) & "," & c.DisplayFormat.NumberFormat & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
End Function
